title: The tuning-target table (GEN.503): the published statistics the tunable draws are tuned to
note: One entry per published statistic. A tunable row of the possibility tables must have a target here (TargetTable.require). A value measured only in the Solar System is a test-point with the solar_system flag, never a target. Labels: READ, DATA, COMPUTED, 2ND-HAND may be tuned to; SNIPPET, RECALLED and NOT REACHED are listed and never tuned to. Source: docs/design/tunable-gaps.md.

targets.statistic: mean of log10 fO2 above the iron-wuestite buffer (dIW) of the rocky material that polluted white dwarfs, 22 values
targets.source: Doyle 2020 Table 1 and Doyle 2023 Table 4 (22 values, 2 upper limits left out): mean -1.25, standard error 0.10 (tunable-gaps.md section 3.2, group3-redox-wd-radio.md; the worker computed it and the tunable-gaps lane re-ran it)
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a mean of the drawn dIW more than 2 sigma from -1.25 over 2000 seeds; until GEN.508 builds the white-dwarf pollution detection model the comparison has no cut, so a tuned width is an upper bound

targets.statistic: sample standard deviation of dIW over the same 22 polluted white dwarfs
targets.source: Doyle 2020 Table 1 and Doyle 2023 Table 4: sample sd 0.45 (intrinsic about 0.22 from 13 well-constrained stars); sigma = 0.45 / sqrt(2 x 21), computed here

targets.falsifier: a sample sd of the drawn dIW more than 2 sigma from 0.45 over 2000 seeds; until GEN.508 builds the white-dwarf pollution detection model the comparison has no cut, so a tuned width is an upper bound
